priorPreflightBinding.reuseRule: Prior disposition is reused only where current raw source and canonical whole-question SHA-256 both exactly match. The 11 prior CONTRACT_GAP objects and supported control i004 were read again in full for this focused reassessment; the remaining 132 prior CONFIRMED objects are bound matches with their prior whole-object findings reused, not newly independently reviewed.

unitObservations.currentFinding: Case-to-key fit is item-specific. The old ledger records a narrow supported control at i004; the node also repeats a generic four-choice menu and broad owner answer. Preserve supported repository/domain-access decisions when case facts support them.

unitObservations.objective: Aggregate boundaries, invariants, and transaction scope
unitObservations.currentFinding: Nine prior gaps are bound below. Their business invariants make aggregate enforcement plausible, but the stems do not identify the data/transaction boundary or specify which writes must commit together; the repeated generic alternatives do not isolate that decision.

unitObservations.objective: ORM mapping and leaky persistence abstractions
unitObservations.currentFinding: Prior exact-object review disposition is reused. The objective is about persistence mapping and abstraction leakage; case-specific mapping, identity, query, and lifecycle facts remain the relevant alternatives recorded per item.

unitObservations.objective: Identity Map and Unit of Work
unitObservations.currentFinding: Prior exact-object review disposition is reused. The decision concerns identity/loaded-object consistency and coordinating a unit of work; ordinary scenario invariants alone do not establish that a shared in-memory identity map or commit boundary is required.
i012 remains a gap: immutable input/code references in a published snapshot are visible facts, but no serialized schema evolution, old-reader compatibility, or missing-field default is specified.

unitObservations.objective: DTOs, mappers, anti-corruption boundaries, and domain objects
unitObservations.currentFinding: Prior exact-object review disposition is reused. The relevant distinction is whether an external contract or persistence shape must be translated while protecting domain meaning, not generic coordination.

unitObservations.objective: Lazy/eager loading, proxies, and query ownership
unitObservations.currentFinding: Prior exact-object review disposition is reused. A loading strategy requires actual traversal, query-count, access-lifetime, or caller-boundary facts; do not infer these from a domain operation alone.

unitObservations.objective: Persistence failures, idempotency, retries, and consistency
unitObservations.currentFinding: i016 explicitly states idempotent release and settlement association, so retry concerns are plausible; it does not state a persistence failure, uncertain acknowledgement, replay source, or consistency boundary that justifies the full infrastructure-retry key.

crossItemPattern: Across the 144 current objects, the accepted option ID is owner_preserves_contract and the same four broad wrong-option concepts recur; learner prompts explicitly name the intended interview lens. These patterns corroborate the old item-level findings but are not used as a count-based or universal uniqueness rule. Each key still requires case-specific review.

targetedFindings.gapDisposition: The 11 remain CONTRACT_GAP rather than confirmed false answers: each has some supporting business fact, but lacks a visible fact separating the keyed abstraction from a plausible simpler operation/model. Their generic alternatives and feedback are independently relevant quality defects. No new answer-ID or replacement decision is made.

recommendedClosureScope.candidate: One fixed N07 source package spanning the eight arrays / 144 question objects is the smallest coherent producer boundary if authoring is later authorized, because all eight belong to the same N07 node and the repeated answer/alternative/explanation pattern crosses those files.
recommendedClosureScope.condition: This scope does not require rewriting every item or assigning new IDs. Carry each object forward only after item-level review; preserve supported decisions and use same-ID correction where meaning is unchanged, reserve a new ID for a real primary-decision change.
recommendedClosureScope.reason: A smaller subset would leave the same repeated node-level template in adjacent N07 units and split one node inventory, while a bank-wide rewrite would exceed evidence. Current read-only findings justify planning one node-sized review package, not blanket edits.

limits: The prior detailed whole-object ledger is reused for 132 exact-matching prior CONFIRMED objects; those objects were not re-adjudicated in this targeted update.
The 11 targeted gap dispositions do not establish that each answer is wrong; they identify a missing discriminator between the key and a plausible alternative.
No source, proof, verifier, test, catalog, app, artifact, queue, admission, candidate, runtime, service, commit, or push was changed.
No new product policy, atomicity guarantee, exact-once promise, or replacement ID assignment is proposed.
